test_function_signatures: test pybind11 function signatures to verify docstrings match expected type annotations
test_named_arguments: test pybind11 named arguments including defaults and keyword-only parameter passing
test_arg_and_kwargs: test pybind11 variadic args and kwargs forwarding through bound C++ functions
test_mixed_args_and_kwargs: test pybind11 mixed positional args, variadic args, kwargs, and defaults together
test_args_refcount: test pybind11 reference counting behavior when args are combined with regular arguments
